### What Current Evidence Shows

- **Short-term safety:** Small human studies and short-term trials have generally reported few or no adverse effects, and animal studies suggest low toxicity. You can review clinical safety notes in the NIH [LiverTox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXDBsDIaLiHXmeGWCcID8djuqFfTOJ9bBTThacGkAQmNpVU9U4vcIliBX_aPwGhUUOTJ_83IbAAhghfv7ejVsIusgZCa43Yq830n1eprH4mqCB1KZQRgIATXYUb6A2i-_hcDZLzs8) database.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16CkwRrjKIAoEvpSGgTFXpVZIj4m0cpAqxA02HPIijREUJJYeAiQgUclPKvIpgV6ShoCJ92raRxcrmNYgBDGw9rV7zzA6ZEJsFWP62WE_x3YdXsZF2Ow5f_LOrH6dcjhT0-k10K4SsawTTPuZHpY-gVEUT8YmfYRHWeS9hYDF2hMt25pUZagib1EWfzcVIWTlNg2oRSDJSh6Ee0hBi2xNQg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXDBsDIaLiHXmeGWCcID8djuqFfTOJ9bBTThacGkAQmNpVU9U4vcIliBX_aPwGhUUOTJ_83IbAAhghfv7ejVsIusgZCa43Yq830n1eprH4mqCB1KZQRgIATXYUb6A2i-_hcDZLzs8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15f8OyJ-j_CvLE4X8yJKQVpEIsX7wGrteR6cObOvnrJNoq6hVtMGW8dQIN-p3HdG3Ytuew71W6ops19oEdaGosr1RRQ3KFcwiO-0Fque_RDS0_CZ3icdY0a-wy6yfdkXcaYwxrKwC2SbagbAAp4QloGf6idxZJm5Si_mMtzqn1TZWlOEI5Tv8TrtAQ)
- **Unknown long-term safety:** There is limited human research overall, and long-term daily safety in people remains unproven.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16CkwRrjKIAoEvpSGgTFXpVZIj4m0cpAqxA02HPIijREUJJYeAiQgUclPKvIpgV6ShoCJ92raRxcrmNYgBDGw9rV7zzA6ZEJsFWP62WE_x3YdXsZF2Ow5f_LOrH6dcjhT0-k10K4SsawTTPuZHpY-gVEUT8YmfYRHWeS9hYDF2hMt25pUZagib1EWfzcVIWTlNg2oRSDJSh6Ee0hBi2xNQg)

Many commercial DHM products are marketed for occasional use rather than daily routines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1yzRyerIV3Ihzs-nCTm2afmUNs6x79CzV2IQijWG2BDkb4Q8Y7tDTmpUe7XuIE4gd2e_pZFqhsS2LSMKPd31umwbrN_KJk2KpiKkrLsA5hrX_EP3UtJtjmvtO7h8FSvr1tBBmAsWkzAF6GEEdteK4Lu5MP9M4-M9hWcMqZHvCSzT9oK9hRm2RBlBjfVqLnnUsrtXb0fg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXDBsDIaLiHXmeGWCcID8djuqFfTOJ9bBTThacGkAQmNpVU9U4vcIliBX_aPwGhUUOTJ_83IbAAhghfv7ejVsIusgZCa43Yq830n1eprH4mqCB1KZQRgIATXYUb6A2i-_hcDZLzs8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF15f8OyJ-j_CvLE4X8yJKQVpEIsX7wGrteR6cObOvnrJNoq6hVtMGW8dQIN-p3HdG3Ytuew71W6ops19oEdaGosr1RRQ3KFcwiO-0Fque_RDS0_CZ3icdY0a-wy6yfdkXcaYwxrKwC2SbagbAAp4QloGf6idxZJm5Si_mMtzqn1TZWlOEI5Tv8TrtAQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wWuW94sIz91alrYdlBBcUQE6sVE22WfpViMhotGA6FwYvZR10kfPkrSNsRzbmMahb_KXTgFz8pOnq4JTugHkshLzJe5BGvv_uhV8fPd35ivjoYgziELKCsilr90CpycFULGs_5Pi7TIkL1SIy-vgEK0wDyzVCkc-DxL7-mP0fJrlt8)
